# go-modern-maps-copy

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use maps.Copy to copy entries from one map into another.

## Details

maps.Copy copies all entries from one map into another, overwriting existing keys in the destination.
It replaces loops whose body only assigns `dst[k] = v`.

## Examples

### Before

```go
for k, v := range src {
  dst[k] = v
}
```

### After

```go
maps.Copy(dst, src)
```
